quote: In addition to the supervised reader above, we also incorporate a LLM as the downstream reader to benchmark the few-shot QA performance of Beam Retrieval augmented LLM.

Generally, we use Exact Match (EM) and F1 scores to evaluate the retrieval performance. ... For MuSiQue-Ans, we report the standard F1based metrics for the answer (An) and support passage identification (Sp). ... For HotpotQA and 2WikiMultihopQA, we report the EM and F1 metrics for the answer prediction task (Ans) and supporting facts prediction task (Sup).
Generally, we use Exact Match (EM) and F1 scores to evaluate the retrieval performance.
